title: Scaling Indic Pretraining: 2.8 Trillion Tokens and an Open Data Generation Pipeline
hook_text: Nvidia just leveled up Indic AI
hook_before: Nvidia just released a massive new pipeline for training Indic language models.
script:
Two point eight trillion tokens trained by Nvidia. They used a massive new pipeline for Indic language models.
They successfully pretrained models using two point eight trillion tokens.
This project creates a blueprint for scaling AI across diverse languages.
The team published an open data generation pipeline on Hugging Face.
It targets complex linguistic regions often ignored by standard training sets.
You can now access these open resources to build localized applications.
Could this finally bridge the global language gap in machine learning?
